ValidationRule.description: The SME field is required for France
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: !ISCHANGED(Status__c) && !ISCHANGED(Number_of_Contacts__c) && !ISCHANGED(Attachments__c) && $UserRole.DeveloperName<>'France_BeNeLux_Africa' && $Profile.Name<>'System Administrator' && $Profile.Name <>'Global Delegated Admin' && $Profile.Name <>'Global Controlling User' && Corporate_Country__c = "France" && ISPICKVAL( SME__c ,"")
